name: WordPerfect Office
summary: Corel's desktop office suite for Windows: word processor, spreadsheet and presentations with Reveal Codes, Microsoft file compatibility and PDF forms, sold as a one-time licence.
best_for: Windows users and organisations that already work with WordPerfect documents or Reveal Codes, or that want a desktop office suite on a one-time licence instead of a subscription
skip_if: anyone on your team works on a Mac or Chromebook; or you only need to edit PDFs, where a dedicated PDF editor costs less than a full suite
honest_knock: It runs on Windows 10 and 11 only, so a mixed Mac or Chromebook team cannot standardise on it. Prices move sharply between promotions ($184.99 to $249.99 for Standard within a week), Home & Student does not qualify for later upgrades, and the money-back guarantee only covers purchases made directly from Corel.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Home & Student · one-time purchase of the download as shown on the US English product pages
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-22 on the WordPerfect product pages at wordperfect.com, US English; dollar prices) WordPerfect Office is sold as a one-time purchase, not a subscription. On 22 October 2026 the full version download was $99.99 for Home & Student, $249.99 for Standard and $399.99 for Professional. The same pages showed lower prices a week earlier, on 15 October: $74.99, $184.99 and $299.99, with upgrades at $119.99 for Standard and $194.99 for Professional. Prices clearly move with promotions, so check the page on the day you buy. An upgrade requires a previous licensed version of WordPerfect Office, and Academic, Home & Student, OEM and Not for Resale versions do not qualify. The Perfect Authority add-on is a separate purchase. Corel offers a 30-day trial of WordPerfect Office Standard without a credit card, and a 30-day money-back guarantee that applies only to products bought directly from Corel and excludes maintenance products.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: The Perfect Authority add-on is a separate purchase.

compare_with.name: Foxit
compare_with.why: Foxit is in our dossiers too and is the alternative if what you mainly need is editing and filling PDFs rather than a full office suite: when we read it on 22 September 2026, Foxit PDF Editor was $129.99 per user a year. WordPerfect Office Standard is a one-time purchase that includes a word processor, spreadsheet and presentations as well as PDF forms, so it is the better buy only if you need the whole suite.
